model.name: FIELD//ZERO terrain analog similarity model
model.label: TERRAIN ANALOG MODEL: compares four DEM-derived surface-shape metrics only. It is not proof of complete environmental equivalence.
model.disclaimer: Scores describe statistical closeness of terrain-shape metrics to the reference distribution of one Mars site (Jezero) or one Moon site (Taurus-Littrow). They do not describe geology, composition, regolith, gravity, atmosphere, temperature, pressure, radiation, illumination or any other environmental property. No location in this output is a confirmed planetary analog; ranked locations are candidates for further study.

candidate_rules.selection: Cells ranked by overall score; greedy selection skipping any cell closer than minSeparationM to an already selected candidate. Distance is Euclidean in local transverse-Mercator metres.

search_domain: Only the Earth Western Desert terrain window present in the processed datasets (not all of Earth, not all of the Western Desert).

source.dataset: Mars 2020 Science Investigation CTX DEM Mosaic 20 m (USGS Astrogeology)
